sn55.52:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu sāvatthiyaṃ vassaṃ vuttho kapilavatthuṃ anuppatto hoti kenacideva karaṇīyena.
sn55.52:1.3: assosuṃ kho kāpilavatthavā sakkā aññataro kira bhikkhu sāvatthiyaṃ vassaṃ vuttho kapilavatthuṃ anuppattoti.
sn55.52:2.1: atha kho kāpilavatthavā sakkā yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho kāpilavatthavā sakkā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn55.52:2.2: kacci bhante, bhagavā arogo ca balavā cāti? bhagavā āvuso
sn55.52:3.1: kacci pana bhante, sāriputtamoggallānā arogā ca balavanto cāti?
sn55.52:3.2: sāriputtamoggallānāpi kho āvuso, arogā ca balavanto cāti.
sn55.52:4.1: kacci pana bhante, bhikkhusaṅgho arogo ca balavā cāti?
sn55.52:4.2: bhikkhusaṅghopi kho āvuso, arogo ca balavā cāti.
sn55.52:5.1: atthi pana bhante, kiñci iminā antaravassena bhagavato sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitanti?
sn55.52:5.2: sammukhā metaṃ āvuso, bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
sn55.52:5.3: “appakā te bhikkhave, bhikkhū ye āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ ceto vimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti.
sn55.52:5.4: atha kho eteva bahutarā bhikkhū ye pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātikā tattha parinibbāyino anāvattidhammā tasmā lokā”ti.
sn55.52:6.1: aparampi kho me āvuso bhagavato sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
sn55.52:6.2: “appakā te bhikkhave, bhikkhū ye pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātikā tattha parinibbāyino anāvattidhammā tasmā lokā.
sn55.52:6.3: atha kho eteva bahutarā bhikkhū ye tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmino sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karissantī”ti.
sn55.52:7.1: aparampi kho me āvuso bhagavato sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ:
sn55.52:7.2: appakā te bhikkhave, bhikkhū ye tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmino, sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karissanti.
sn55.52:7.3: atha kho eteva bahutarā bhikkhū ye tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyanā”ti.
